pr.title: Invoice search, share link, notes and CSV export
pr.author: Crashtest author agent

issue.title: Invoice search, share link, notes and CSV export
issue.body:
As someone who sends a lot of invoices, I want to find invoices quickly, share one with a client without making them sign up, keep a note on an invoice, and take my list into a spreadsheet, so I spend less time hunting through pages and answering "can you send that again?" emails.

## Acceptance criteria

1. On the invoice list I can search by client name or invoice number. Search combines with the status filter, and both survive paging.
2. Each row of the invoice list also shows how many line items the invoice has.
3. An invoice has a free-text notes field. I can edit it; it shows on the invoice page.
4. I can create a public share link for an invoice. Anyone with the link sees a read-only page of that invoice (client, line items, total, notes) without signing in. I can revoke the link, after which it shows "not found".
5. I can export the invoices I am looking at (current search and filter) as a CSV file.
6. Everything that worked before still works.

intro: This change adds four things to the invoice app: search on the invoice list, a free-text notes field, a public share link that can be revoked, and a CSV export of the current list. Each list row also shows how many line items the invoice has. The database gets two new invoice columns and a per-workspace change counter that the export cache uses.

stops.title: Old databases get the two new invoice columns when they are opened
stops.why: Notes and share links need two new columns on `invoices`. `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` does not change a table that already exists, so the code adds missing columns with `ALTER TABLE` each time a database is opened.

blocks.text: An invoice gets two new fields. `notes` is always a string. `share_token` is `null` until a share link is created.
A new database gets both columns from the `CREATE TABLE` statement.

tokens: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
workspace_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id),
client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id),
status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'sent', 'paid')),

blocks.text: A database made before this change already has an `invoices` table, so the statement above does nothing for it. This list names the columns to add. The indexes that need those columns are kept apart, so they can be created afterwards.

tokens: /** Columns added after the first release. Databases created earlier get them through ALTER TABLE. */
// Indexes on added columns; created once the columns exist.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS invoices_share_token ON invoices (share_token) WHERE share_token IS NOT NULL;
-- Covers the invoice search scan (list order plus everything it filters and counts on), so it never reads table rows.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS invoices_workspace_search ON invoices (workspace_id, issue_date DESC, id DESC, number, client_id, status, due_date);
